primary_goal: 在不拆分 SSD/NVMe/HBF 三个模型的前提下，验证并接入一个可解释的 NAND family page/plane/die/channel 访问粒度与并行窗口。
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

baseline.role: H24 DRAM/HBM shared-lane promotion plus H25 runtime negative scan

previous_direction: 运行速度与内存（H25 负向扫描）
direction_switch_reason: H25 证伪现有 aggregate-only 生产调用后不改源码；按用户定向任务转向尚未进入真实执行链路的 NAND/SSD/HBF 共享家族。
recent_directions: H23:正确性/工具链负向发现
H25:运行速度/报告调用链负向

scope.family: SSD/NVMe/NAND/HBF 使用一个 NAND family model，变体只保留 profile 差异
scope.candidate: 现有 hbf_media/PhysicalService/endpoint_service 是否可统一承载 page/plane/die/channel 与读/program/erase 粒度、并行窗口和 host queue
exclude: 新增三个独立介质模型

problem_domain_closure.contract: optional nand_media_v1 reaches SSD/high_io_ssd/NVMe/HBF PhysicalService.price and endpoint_service; legacy hbf_media aliases remain compatible.
problem_domain_closure.accounting: page split, host transaction/request queue, read/program latency, unaligned write RMW, physical_planes cap media_parallelism and physical byte/energy accounting are covered.
problem_domain_closure.presets: standard SSD/NVMe/HBF presets remain generic by design; no universal page/plane/die/channel defaults are inferred without source-backed geometry.
problem_domain_closure.unsupported: die/channel/block/erase/FTL/GC remain unknown or unsupported; no host erase workload invented.
problem_domain_closure.controls: generic SSD baseline, explicit SSD/NVMe candidate, non-default page=8192, legacy HBF, HBF integration, DRAM isolation and invalid contracts covered.

data_roles.development: fresh NAND source scan、hbf_media 与 SSD/NVMe presets/test controls
data_roles.holdout: page-aligned/unaligned、read/program/erase、plane/die parallelism、HBF cold_page and generic storage controls
data_roles.final_acceptance: 工程/机制回归；无 Native 精度验收

guardrails: SSD/NVMe/HBF 只复用一个 NAND family model
不要把 DRAM parallel_lanes 复制到 NAND
只在真实执行/计费链路找到缺口后改源码
FTL/GC 只有独立瓶颈证据才加入
不声称 Native 或 cycle accuracy
next_step: H26 已发布；下一轮切换到计算成本模型方向，寻找独立的 GEMM/归约/内存/链路成本候选；NAND preset activation 和 erase/FTL 只有新来源/调用链证据时重开。
